gen-dafont-quantum-gf-krub: Krub reads with a big, generous x-height and curves that stop before closing. Quantum counters with stencil-cut letters of one steady width, crisp and techy, while Krub's open loops keep the running text easy on the eye.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-kufam: Clean and a bit neon, Quantum spaces its letters loosely with open mouths, while Kufam sets a single tube-like track width with generous curves in the e. Quantum is the showpiece; Kufam is the workhorse.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-lexend-deca: Lexend Deca draws a plain, unshaded line that never swells. Quantum is the standout with its loose letterfit and compressed ascenders, and the body's small capitals beside big lowercase keep the text approachable and unfussy.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-liter: Crisp and spacious, Quantum lets its letters breathe with wide-open mouths, and Liter follows with sans lowercase of great vertical presence and no stroke contrast. Give Quantum a generous size so its loose spacing shows.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mada: Stencil-straight and spaced out, Quantum draws vertical and horizontal strokes at identical weight, and Mada replies with curves that refuse to close under a towering midzone. Their openness is what ties them together.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-maven-pro: Quantum's loose letterfit leaves lots of breathing space, with mouths that stay open and ascenders cut short. And Maven Pro, a sans-serif with a gentle monotone line and a welcoming gap in the c, carries that openness into the text.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-michroma: Thin as rope and cleanly techy, Quantum outlines every letter with no thick or thin parts. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, so the sans text and the outlined heading both keep plenty of daylight.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire, with an s that opens generously between its bends and a lowercase of cast-iron stature. Quantum does the techy, spaced-out heading work, while Miriam Libre handles the sturdy running text.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-mozilla-text: Quantum sets bowls as heavy as its stems, spaced loosely with open mouths and short ascenders, giving the heading a clean tech feel. Mozilla Text brings flared terminals and bold-looking lowercase.
gen-dafont-quantum-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart, with a full-bodied c, s and z. And Quantum, cut from one gauge of tubing, carries that clean spacing up into the heading.
